brief:
Israeli figures have backed Argentina's sovereignty claim over the Falkland Islands, Middle East Eye reported. The development comes as Britain intensifies criticism of Israeli policy in Gaza and the occupied West Bank. Former US President Donald Trump has hinted the United States may reconsider its historical support for Britain's claim to the South Atlantic territory.

The timing reflects broader diplomatic tensions between London and Jerusalem over the Gaza conflict. Israeli endorsements of Argentina's position mark a notable shift in the geopolitical positioning of the dispute, traditionally considered a bilateral matter between Britain and Argentina.

title: Netanyahu's son backs Argentina on Falklands; Trump signals US review
